interpretation_guardrails: IITK is a recording-level seeded-fault benchmark, not a temporal precursor benchmark.
Global average precision has a high prevalence baseline because 1575 of 1620 test recordings are faults.
Per-fault ROC-AUC against the same 45 held-out healthy recordings is a primary class-wise ranking check.
Explanation groups are five acoustic feature families; raw N_eff is not directly comparable to MetroPT sensor-group N_eff.
Feature-family contribution is detector evidence, not physical root cause.
No detector or representation is promoted from this exploratory research branch.
